note: Path-prefix -> landing zone, per scene-writeback-contract.md 1.2. LONGEST PREFIX WINS, because roots mix: StPetersWharf holds an authored-looking Deck and generated Fittings under one name. Zone (c) is deliberately absent — it classifies an EDIT (anything that changes baked pixels), not an entity, so it cannot be a per-entity value. A prefix absent from this table exports no zone at all rather than a guessed one. A prefix with "resolve": false is deliberately left out of the rig-resolution map and is NOT counted as an unresolved gap.

zones.a: an authored table row — a literal list of constants; an edit here is a one-value change to one row
zones.b: a generator with no row to edit — scatters, spacing loops and hashed variants; moving one means an exception list the builder does not have yet
